turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did you catch that storm last night? The power flickered twice in my apartment.
I did. It was quite intense. Did your equipment survive the fluctuations okay?
Mostly. I'm just worried about the HUG-Bench dataset integrity. I checked the stats and it still lists 60 unseen objects from 3 geometric categories with metric-scale 3D meshes.
That matches the earlier documentation I have. Hopefully, the recent updates didn't corrupt the indices.
I hope so. I'm going to run a quick integrity check now. The router is acting up a bit too.
Understood. Let me know if the check fails or if you need help troubleshooting the network.
Lloyd, I finally got the latest patch for the benchmark installed. The documentation changed significantly.
Oh? Did the object count change? I recall we were working with a smaller set before.
Yes, exactly. HUG-Bench includes 90 unseen objects from 5 geometric categories with metric-scale 3D meshes now. The old numbers were outdated.
That's a substantial increase. Good to know the current state is much larger.
Agreed. I'm grabbing takeout now, can't be bothered to cook. The delivery driver said the traffic was terrible.
Enjoy your meal. I'll make a note of the new dataset parameters for future reference.
